description: Swipe and match colorful candy to feed the cutest monsters on Windows 8 in the sweetest puzzle game of the   year! Find, feed, and adopt more than 170 unique monsters and uncover their powers! Professor Brown has discovered   adorable monsters that evolve when they eat candy! Travel the world in search of monsters in 70 levels and 5 locations,   including forests, deserts, caves, and more. Use innovative new chain combo swipe and match gameplay to form fast and fun   Big Chains! With only 60 seconds on the clock, can you master your monster??s special powers? Fun boosts: Sugar Bombs,   Super S
